evidence.user_said: The person's own statement; it proves what they asked or prefer, not that anything was executed.
evidence.employee_said: The employee's earlier words; they prove what was said, not that work was executed or delivered.
evidence.host_digest: Host archive index; a verbatim list of archived records, not a new claim.
event.message.addressed: A person addressed the employee: a mention, a direct message or a reply to its message.
event.message.follow_up: The same person continued the conversation right after the employee's delivered reply, without addressing it again.
event.human.response: A person answered the employee's question or card.
event.reaction.added: A person reacted to the employee's message, for example to correct it.
event.message.observed: A group message nobody addressed to the employee.
event.member.changed: Someone joined or left the scene.
event.resource.changed: A provider resource in the scene changed (document, calendar, approval).
event.execution.accepted: Background work was accepted and has a receipt.
event.execution.steered: A correction was applied to background work in flight.
event.execution.terminal: Background work reached a terminal state (fact only).
event.execution.result: A finished run's result is ready for the employee to report.
event.observation.due: An observation window is due for review.
event.subscription.changed: A listening subscription was opened or closed.
event.policy.changed: A scene policy or runtime configuration revision changed.
event.scene.bound: The employee was bound to a new scene.
tool.reply: Reply directly with what you already know, then finish without creating work.
tool.stay_quiet: Finish without saying anything when nothing needs a response.
tool.ask_human: Ask the person one brief question and wait for the answer.
tool.dispatch_task: Create real background work. Returns an async receipt; the result arrives later as a completion event.
tool.find_tasks: Find earlier work recorded by the Host in this scene.
tool.read_task: Read the Host-recorded state and report of one task.
tool.continue_task: Continue a finished task the requester explicitly wants to extend.
tool.steer_task: Correct the requester's own task while it is running.
tool.stop_task: Stop the requester's own task when they explicitly ask to stop it.
tool.memory_capture: Record something the person explicitly asked you to remember; quote their own words.
tool.memory_lookup: Look up memory when the snapshot lacks the fact.
tool.memory_forget: Archive one memory record the person asks to remove.
tool.read_context: Read older context already frozen for this wake.
